reviews.text: So far this app is great. It’s simple but gives you what you need. I have a couple suggestions though. 1. A voice command for when you are done with a set so it starts your the rest break that way you don’t have to always go to your phone to start the break. 2. Although I like the add your own exercise feature some exercises, especially abs do not require a dumbbell if you could make it possible to have a no weight feature that would be worthy of 5 stars.

reviews.text: I love this app. It simple to set up and use. It does 90% of what I want. The pre-built daily workouts are well designed. You can easily adjust them, add exercises and modify the order. My only complaint is that I wish it had more built in exercises in each group. You can add a custom exercise but you lose the visual. $10 for full lifetime access is great.
